title: finding(plugin-detail): the inline date editor (`InlineFieldInput`) silently blanks an impossible stored day — the third editor of the objectui#10567 class
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site and a reproduction (class a). reach: the editor rendered with a stored impossible day shows an empty control with no marker (probe below). Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10567 (PR objectui#10618). ⛔ Not graded and not routed.

## The defect

objectui#10474 (PR objectui#10566) and objectui#10567 (PR objectui#10618) close the silent blank for an impossible stored day in `@object-ui/fields`' date-time and date-only editors. With nothing stored as a real date, the control shows empty, marked `aria-invalid`, beside a notice naming the stored string. That is objectui#10026 direction A: never roll, never blank silently.

`@object-ui/plugin-detail`'s `InlineFieldInput` has its own native date branch. `isDate` covers both `date` and `datetime` fields, and it slices the stored value to its leading `YYYY-MM-DD` into an `input type=date`. Chromium sanitises `2026-02-30` to an empty value, so a stored impossible day shows an empty inline editor with no marker and no notice. This is the silent-blank shape direction A rules out, on a third editor.

## Reproduction (the dev's uncommitted happy-dom render at objectui `origin/main` `21d34d5e2`, ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

- A stored `2026-02-30` on a `date` field, and a stored `2026-02-30T10:00:00Z` on a `datetime` field, each give an `input type=date` with value `''`, value attribute `2026-02-30`, `aria-invalid` null, `aria-describedby` null, and no notice.
- Chromium 141 sanitises the same value to empty (the objectui#10567 probe).

## Fix shape (for triage, not a grade)

Reuse `@object-ui/fields`' `isImpossibleStoredDay` and the date-only notice key `fields.date.impossibleDay` that PR objectui#10618 adds, following that PR's form. ⛔ No second predicate. It lands after PR objectui#10618.

## Second site, read at source only (reach NOT measured end to end, for triage's judgement)

`packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`'s inline cell editor keeps private copies of `toDateInputValue` / `toDateTimeInputValue` with no impossible-day check:
- Its datetime copy goes through `new Date(String(value))` and local getters. The dev evaluated that exact expression for a stored `2026-02-30T10:00:00Z` under `TZ=UTC` and got `2026-03-02T10:00`, and `onChange` re-emits through `new Date(v).toISOString()`. That is the objectui#10474 roll, on a second copy of the adapter.
- Its date copy has objectui#10567's silent blank.

Not rendered end to end, so recorded here rather than carded on its own.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18, open and closed). `InlineFieldInput` ⇒ 7 (PR objectui#10618, and closed items on other defects: objectui#7190, PRs objectui#10542 / objectui#10255 / objectui#10252 / objectui#10231 / objectui#10182). `impossible (stored )?day` ⇒ 8, `2026-02-30` ⇒ 11, `toDateTimeInputValue` ⇒ 3, `isImpossibleStoredDay` ⇒ 3: all the `fields` / `core` family (objectui#10026, #10301, #10474, #10567 and their PRs), none about `plugin-detail` or `data-table`. No card carries this.

Dedupe words: `InlineFieldInput impossible day blank` · `plugin-detail inline date 2026-02-30 empty` · `data-table toDateTimeInputValue impossible day`
